items.myth: Visa officer ko perfect English chahiye
items.detail: Simple English mein seedha jawab do. Accent se fark nahi padta.
Ratta lagta hai, sunne wale ko pata chalta hai. Points yaad rakho, lines nahi.
Documents ready rakho, par apna plan bhi samjha pao.
